title: Genlock speaker: one loaded engine that speaks a project's text a sentence at a time

requirements.text: genlock voice serve runs a local HTTP speaker (127.0.0.1, port in ~/.genlock/voice/serve.json) that keeps the model loaded; a client that finds none starts it detached
requirements.check: manual: two genlock voice sample calls through the server; the second has no ~5s load (time each)

requirements.text: POST /speak {text, root|project|voice} streams one clip per sentence (sentence text + audio) as NDJSON, first clip before the whole text is made
requirements.check: manual: curl a 4-sentence text and see the first line arrive before the last is made

requirements.text: The voice used is the project's recorded voice (read from ROOT/.genlock/records/project.jsonl, assigned via genlock voice there if none); untagged text uses a hub voice set by genlock voice set --hub
requirements.check: tests/voices.mjs case: voiceAt(root) of a repo with a set voice returns it

requirements.text: Clips can be asked for as m4a (afconvert AAC, for the phone) or wav (for the Mac)
requirements.check: manual: file on an m4a clip says MPEG-4 audio

text: Not started. Design in goal genlock-voice latest and T-GR4VV decisions: one Mac speaker, NDJSON clip per sentence, m4a for phone via afconvert. Start here.

evidence: genlock voice sample twice via the speaker (code-stamped restart): first sentence 9.0s cold (load), 2.9s warm on a machine at load avg ~86; earlier quieter run 11.2s -> 1.2s. serve.json has port/pid/build
curl POST /speak 4 sentences, m4a: lines arrived 08:40:06.6, 09.9, 12.9, 15.9 then done at 16.1 - first clip ~9s before the last
tests/voices.mjs: voiceAt(b) -> bf_emma:0.6,af_heart:0.4; unvoiced repo assigned+recorded; voiceFor({project:'beta'}) by projects.json; hub via genlock voice set --hub bm_lewis; 31 passed
file c0.m4a from /speak format m4a: ISO Media, Apple iTunes ALAC/AAC-LC (.M4A) Audio
npm test: 577 passed, 0 failed; tests/voices.mjs 31 passed, 0 failed

text: Kokoro on this Intel i7 is ~1.1x realtime per sentence when the machine is quiet
breaks: under load (avg 86 measured) a sentence takes longer to make than to play, so listeners hear gaps between sentences

answers.observed: timings from genlock voice sample output and curl line timestamps above; tests counts from npm test
answers.cause: cold first sentence is the ~5s model load plus first-request work, measured by warm vs cold, not hypothesised
answers.absence: not tested: two clients at once (they queue, by design), a blend through the server, idle exit after 30 min
answers.assumption: mine: project names in bridge items match a projects.json folder basename (genlock -> agent-genlock by substring); wrong -> item spoken in hub voice
answers.falsify: a warm second sample with first sentence >5s on a quiet machine, or a project item spoken in the hub voice

text: British voices use espeak-ng lang 'en': it has no 'en-gb', which made every British voice fail with 'Failed to set eSpeak-ng voice'
